text_block_list.text:
The day of the practice match against Team 
<First>!

The team members huddled up, their eyes 
locked onto a single point.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Today is finally the rematch! Let's win 
this together, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: <HOP CHEERS>...!

text_block_list.name: Team Members
text_block_list.text: Fight, oh!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: <Harenohi Runners>...!

text_block_list.name: Team Members
text_block_list.text: Fight, oh!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: <Carrot Pudding>...!

text_block_list.name: Team Members
text_block_list.text: Fight, oh!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: The "Blooms"...!

text_block_list.name: Team Members
text_block_list.text: Fight, oh!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Team <Carrots>...!

text_block_list.name: Team Members
text_block_list.text: Fight, oh!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Okaaay! I'm completely fired up!

However, looking at the excited team, one 
Umamusume cast a cold, chilling gaze 
toward them.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Heh... If winning were that simple, 
nobody'd have any trouble.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
What's gotten into you all of a sudden, 
Little Cocon? Aren't you being unusually 
cold to them?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Things like that really piss me off. 
Getting all fired up on pure feelings 
alone.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
While you guys were goofing off and 
chit-chatting, I was busting my butt 
training.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: ...Like hell I'm gonna lose!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
M-Mmh! To be sure, everyone was doing 
plenty of hard training, but—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
However! We've also put our all into 
polishing our skills!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm a little anxious on my own, but as a 
team, I don't feel like we can lose!

And with that, the spark-flying race 
began—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeees! I'm the winner!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Teyaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, were you watching!? I was thiiis 
close to winning, right!?

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: I can do it! I will do it! Pure guts~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Today's fortune is Moderate Luck!! It's 
just so-so, but!! I'm not gonna lose~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, so close! Still, as expected of 
"Moderate Luck," that was a race we can 
learn from!

—Fighting bravely to a 2-2 tie, the 
showdown finally dragged into the final 
long-distance race.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If I don't win the next race, the team 
will lose...! I have to win, no matter 
what...!

Standing in the stands, Rice Shower's 
fingertips were trembling.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
*Inhale*... *exhale*... You can do it, 
Rice, you can do it...

Just as I opened my mouth to say 
something—

text_block_list.name: Team Members
text_block_list.text: Hold on a sec~!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Everyone...!?

The team members came sprinting straight 
toward Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Rice-chaaan! Look, look! It's amazing! 
That cloud looks like an elephant!

Rice Shower looked up at the sky too. Her 
tense expression instantly softened.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Whoa, you're right...! It's hugeee...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Isn't it amazing! Its trunk is 
going *paooon*!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Mr. Elephant is watching too! You'll do 
great, Rice-chan! Hip, hip, hooray!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Urara-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Rice-san, here! This is a blessed charm 
for victory from a miraculous shrine!

Matikanefukukitaru handed a small 
protective charm to Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Whoa...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Rice-chan~~! Go for ittt!

And finally, Taiki Shuttle came over and 
gave Rice Shower a big, tight hug.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Did it right this time! Hugging is 
super relaxing, you know!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "Are you all right? Are you not scared?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Truth be told, just a little... But 
everyone's here, so I'll be fine."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: ...Oh! Heheh!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Please win, Rice! I know you can do it, 
YES!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah..., that's true...

—And with that, Rice Shower looks around 
at the gathered team members.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah...! Rice is going to go win...!

Giving a firm nod, Rice Shower dashed off 
toward the gates.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, haaah, damn it...! Just how long 
are you gonna keep chasing me?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "*pant, pant, pant*! I-I won't lose...!"

Two runners dashing across the track. Rice 
Shower was right on Little Cocon's heels.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose either! I won't lose to a 
team that's all about fun, where people 
just laugh off their defeats...!

—Approaching the final corner, Little 
Cocon accelerated with all her might!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
She ran 3,000m and still has that much 
power left?! That's incredible, Little 
Cocon-san...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: D-Do your best! Rice-saaaan!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: "Ruuun! Rice-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: We've got your back~!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yaaah!

Rice Shower chases relentlessly with 
furious momentum, as if displaying her 
true bottomless strength.

The two lunged toward the finish line, 
and—

By the slimmest of margins, Little Cocon 
seized the victory.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Ha, ha...! Dammit...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice's team...! Isn't just a team for 
having fun...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Being with them makes me feel motivated to 
give it my all—that's the kind of team 
this is...!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, I see.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for today. I was able to confirm 
that there are still areas I need to 
improve upon.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...I believe it served as good inspiration 
for my team. Next time, at the Aoharu Cup.

The result was a loss... but even so, it 
was a race that showed tremendous growth!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, Rice did it again...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No, no! Very, very gooood!! That was a 
nice run!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Especially how Rice chased from behind! I 
was... I was truly moved!

Just then, a faintly familiar voice could 
be heard.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... It seems Acting Principal Kashimoto 
hasn't changed after all. What a shame...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Hm!? Oh! Everyone!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I watched the team match! Seeing your 
splendid growth was truly magnificent!

If it's Chairwoman Akikawa, she should be 
able to stop Acting Director Kashimoto. 
Holding that wish, just as I was about to 
explain—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I have heard the details from Tazuna! You 
all went through tremendous hardship!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
However, due to unforeseen circumstances, 
we've decided to wait and see!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"I shall leave the academy's operations in 
Acting Director Kashimoto's hands for a 
while longer! Dismissed!"

Leaving behind a shocking answer, 
Chairwoman Akikawa calmly walked away...!
